observations: Single photo shows a used automatic transmission/gearbox unit sitting on bare ground/pavement.
Casing shows oil residue, dirt, and general wear consistent with a used part.
A watermark reading 'JP AUTO SPARE PARTS' is visible in the image, apparently from the seller/shop, not a part identifier.
No manufacturer plate, part number, or '22pin' marking is legible anywhere on the casing.
No wiring harness, torque converter, or mounting bolts shown in detail; only one angle of the unit is given.
No video or sound test, no fluid check, no bench test shown.

identity.kind: used automatic transmission/gearbox (claimed Lexus ES350 fitment)

claims.evidence: No part number, pin-count label, or Lexus markings are visible in photo 0 to confirm model or year fitment.
No receipt, shop signage, or written warranty terms shown in the photo; warranty claims from a single image cannot be confirmed.
Subjective seller language; no functional test or comparison shown.
No import documentation, auction sheet, or Japanese export sticker visible on the unit.

risks.risk: Transmission may not shift properly or may have internal wear/failure not visible externally.
risks.proof: A video clip of the gearbox being bench-tested or installed and running through gears.

risks.risk: 22-pin connector and year range (2007/2010) may not match the buyer's actual vehicle sub-model, since Lexus ES350 transmissions varied by trim/year.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the connector pin count and any stamped part/casting number on the case.
risks.if_unproven: priced as unconfirmed fitment, risk of return/mismatch

risks.risk: Mileage and prior usage/accident history unknown; could be a salvage unit.
risks.proof: Odometer photo from the donor car or any paperwork linking this unit to a specific vehicle.

risks.risk: Warranty claim may be unenforceable if seller has no fixed shop address or documentation.
risks.proof: Photo of shop front, signage, or a written warranty card with seller contact details.
risks.if_unproven: priced as if no warranty exists

proof_requests: Close-up photo of any stamped part number or casting code on the transmission case.
Clear photo or count of the connector pins to confirm '22pin' claim.
Video of the gearbox being tested (manual rotation or bench test) showing smooth gear engagement.
Photo of the donor vehicle's VIN plate or the original car it was removed from.
Photo of shop signage or written warranty document.
response.reason: This is clearly a used automatic transmission unit by type, but with no model/part number legible and no functional test shown, it must be priced at worst case as an untested used gearbox with unconfirmed fitment and no verifiable warranty.
